summary: Accessible countdown to the start of an event, without actions or event management.
whenToUse: Show the time remaining until a date and time.
whenNotToUse: Handling registration opening or other automatic actions at the deadline.
accessibility: Each unit has its own visible label; the countdown does not use a live announcement every second, to avoid continuous announcements.
responsive: Units wrap onto multiple rows if there is not enough space.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Pass a valid date with an explicit time zone when using a string.
limits: The countdown is presentational and does not trigger actions at the deadline.
